# 7 Deadly Sins Card Game
# Version: 1.0 | Last Updated: March 2026
# For the full context version, see: https://www.7sinscardgame.com/llms-full.txt

## What Is This?

7 Deadly Sins Card Game is a free-to-play, browser-based strategic multiplayer card game where 2-4 players each embody one of the seven deadly sins and battle in a gothic cathedral setting. The game features 7 playable factions, 84+ unique cards, compound mechanics that escalate over 20 rounds, AI-powered narration, and deep strategic depth inspired by games like Slay the Spire, Inscryption, and Magic: The Gathering.

## Core Game Mechanics

### Factions (7 Deadly Sins)
Each faction has a unique passive ability and 12 cards:

- **Wrath** (Ira) — Passive: VENGEANCE. Reflects damage back to the attacker. Aggressive, high-risk playstyle.
- **Sloth** (Acedia) — Passive: ENDURANCE. Generates shield and AOE damage from stored energy. Defensive, attrition-based.
- **Greed** (Avaritia) — Passive: TAX. Damage ticks generate protective shields. Resource accumulation playstyle.
- **Envy** (Invidia) — Passive: JEALOUSY. Dealing damage deepens the target's worst affliction. Debuff-focused.
- **Pride** (Superbia) — Passive: HUBRIS. Playing the most expensive card amplifies all effects. High-cost, high-reward.
- **Lust** (Luxuria) — Passive: TEMPTATION. Damage over time heals you as it hurts them. Sustain and drain.
- **Gluttony** (Gula) — Passive: DEVOURER. Destroying enemy cards feeds your energy. Disruption and consumption.

### Card Types
- **Flat cards**: One-time powerful effects (immediate damage, heal, shield)
- **Compounding cards**: Weaker base value but tick for 3 rounds with Fibonacci scaling (1x, 1x, 2x). Types include damage-over-time (DoT), heal-over-time (HoT), shield-over-time (SoT), and steal effects.

### Energy System (Corruption)
Players spend Corruption energy to play cards. Energy regenerates each round. Each faction has unique energy interactions tied to their sin identity.

### Win Condition
Last player standing after up to 20 rounds of combat. Players start with 100 HP.

## Key Features
- Free-to-play, no downloads, runs in any modern browser
- 2-4 player multiplayer with real-time Supabase synchronization
- AI bot opponents with strategic decision-making
- AI-powered Living Narrator that generates unique gothic commentary each round
- Sin Whisperer: faction-specific AI whispers tempting strategic advice
- Deck Builder for custom deck construction
- Practice Mode against AI opponents
- Community Decks sharing system
- Game Chronicles: AI-generated post-game narrative summaries
- Comprehensive balance analysis and matchup data
- 466+ blog articles covering lore, strategy, game design, and dark fantasy

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Framer Motion
- Backend: Express, tRPC, Drizzle ORM
- Real-time: Supabase Realtime
- AI: Google Gemini for narration and whispers
- Hosting: Manus Platform

## Site Structure

### Public Pages (Indexable)
- **Home** (`/`): Main landing page with faction showcase and game creation
- **Blog** (`/blog`): 466+ articles on lore, strategy, and game design
- **Collection** (`/collection`): Complete card gallery for all 7 factions
- **Rules** (`/rules`): Official game rules and mechanics reference
- **How to Play** (`/how-to-play`): Interactive tutorial and beginner guide
- **Balance Analysis** (`/balance`): Mathematical faction balance data with charts
- **Matchup Matrix** (`/matchups`): Faction vs faction win rate analysis
- **Deck Builder** (`/deck-builder`): Custom deck construction tool
- **Community Decks** (`/community`): Player-shared deck builds
- **Chronicles** (`/chronicles`): AI-generated game story archives
- **Brandbook** (`/brandbook`): Visual identity and design system
- **Practice** (`/practice`): Single-player mode against AI bots
- **Changelog** (`/changelog`): Version history and patch notes

### Private Pages (Not Indexable)
- `/lobby/*`: Multiplayer game lobbies (ephemeral)
- `/game/*`: Active game sessions (ephemeral)
- `/api/*`: Backend API endpoints
- `/auth/*`, `/login`, `/account`, `/profile`: User authentication
